admission.shape: closed `classDef` / `class` / `style` statements over the ER CSS table (hex or named colour, stroke-width, font-size, font-weight) and inline `:::class` entity annotations
admission.disclosure: a presentation-profile source discloses every accepted input; a profile-free source (whose old surface was already admitted silently) discloses only the newly admissible vocabulary, so its art stays byte-identical
admission.width_policy: wide_240 admission only; narrow_40 measured live
admission.twin_rule: the twin is the same fixture with the style statements removed and the `:::class` suffixes cut; the art above the footer must be cell-equal

selection.rule: every remaining er-diagram fallback whose only non-admitted inputs are the closed ER style surface

review.reviewer_agent: two independent read-only adversarial reviews, fresh general-purpose agents, D-460 ER body style admission, 2026-11-24. Correctness/blast radius: round 1 REQUEST-CHANGES (BLOCKER ER206 ordinal bypass; BLOCKER two stale oracles; MINOR legend-suffix loss, footer limits, per-cell styles), round 2 REQUEST-CHANGES (BLOCKER envelope construct-rejection pins 87/10 missed; MINOR path-only ordinal binding), round 3 REQUEST-CHANGES (BLOCKER the C3 fix compared the raw fixture sha against the canonical-record manifest sha), round 4 APPROVE after the canonical tuple fix (task ab84de2ca4d731a22). Contract/process/oracle strength: round 1 REQUEST-CHANGES (BLOCKER ledger pending; MAJOR d117 counts 1745/400; MAJOR `layout` misstated as a projection trigger; MINOR alternatives/disclosure/width-bound/has_projection), round 2 APPROVE (task a18a34f8b7b6f3961) conditional on the mechanical flip and the green matrix/suite runs.
review.note: Approval is void if the post-flip release OfficialMatrix, the dual-preset byte gate or the full debug mermaid suite is red. The fallback roster is regenerated with `--emit` from the approved matrix rerun (never hand-edited); the d117 totals land in the same commit. Measured after approval: release OfficialMatrix 2145 originals 1745 drawn / 400 source_fallback, drawn_at_240 1559, gaps 48, ER summary 68 decoded + 123 pending + 15 cohort = 206 admitted.
